protocol.design: Smooth validation-trained mixture of calibrated passive and static-fusion experts
protocol.limitations: Designed after previous test results were examined; grouped CV prevents extension selection on held-out rows but does not create a fresh untouched test or establish novelty.
gate_features: absolute passive logit normalized by training-fold 90th percentile
falsifiable_criteria: Greater full-test ROC-AUC than passive alone
No more than 0.005 lower AUC than passive on the prior reduced-recovery diagnostic slice
Compare against logit+payload logistic and constant-mixture baselines; report failures
